xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5471: docs: model routing, roles and tiered execution

plan.title: docs: model routing, roles and tiered execution
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Eight doc files only. lintProjectedSurface counts each root-level doc path (concepts.mdx, docs.json, configuration/*, features/*, docs/*) as its own subsystem; the real surface is one docs site.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no user page explaining how it picks the model and harness for each agent. features/cloister.mdx documents a deleted keyword complexity router, concepts.mdx claims automatic routing by task type and budget, and configuration/harnesses.mdx says a per-role harness setting wins although no pipeline spawn reads it.
narratives.Proposal: Add configuration/model-routing.mdx built only from the PRD fact sheet (roles and sub-roles, workhorse slots, distributions, provider harnesses, tiered execution including the settings that are saved but not acted on, presets and effort, check commands), add it to docs.json, replace the two stale routing sections with pointers, correct the harness claims, and link the page from the presets, effort and developer routing docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No source, CLI help, UI text or config schema changes (PAN-5517, PAN-5518, PAN-4512)
- No description of tier promotion, session replay, call-outs or a blocking supervisor as working behavior
- No description of standing per-tier sessions, a dashboard per-issue tiered toggle, or a pan start flag for tiered execution
- No claim that roles.<role>.harness routes pipeline agents
- No rewrite of features/cloister.mdx or concepts.mdx beyond the routing sections and the cloister description (PAN-5472, PAN-5502)
- No accuracy audit of configuration/model-presets.mdx, configuration/harnesses.mdx or configuration/effort.mdx beyond the named edits (PAN-5503)
- No docs.json changes beyond inserting configuration/model-routing (PAN-5483)
- No publishing or editing of blog/standing-crew.mdx
- No new screenshots and no reuse of the stale Panopticon settings screenshot on the new page
- No documentation of project-level .pan.yaml role overrides
- No changelog.d entry

autoDecisions.summary: Document tiered execution settings that are saved but not acted on in one labelled subsection instead of omitting or describing them as working.
autoDecisions.rationale: Settings shows Escalation, Session replay and Call-outs controls; the issue requires every claim to match code, and code shows they do nothing (decideEscalation has no caller, replay code deleted, call-out endpoint missing). Naming them once with links to PAN-5517 and PAN-4512 is accurate and tells users not to rely on them.

autoDecisions.summary: Filed PAN-5517 (inert tiered settings, broken per-issue toggle, stale UI text) and PAN-5518 (roles.<role>.harness ignored) as follow-up bugs; this issue stays docs-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body says docs-only unless behavior changes; fixing runtime behavior is out of scope, but the gaps were verified in code and deserve tracking.

autoDecisions.summary: Document the provider default harness under its YAML key models.providers.<provider>.harness, mentioning providerHarnesses only as the internal name.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names providerHarnesses, but that is the normalized in-memory map; Settings writes and config load reads models.providers.<provider>.harness (providerConfigForSave, applyProviderHarness).

autoDecisions.summary: Use no screenshot on the new page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The only Settings screenshot under images/ shows the Panopticon v0.21 UI without the presets bar; the issue forbids invented UI and stale imagery would mislead.

autoDecisions.summary: Insert the page directly before configuration/model-presets in docs.json, anchored by neighbour rather than position.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5483 (PR #5508) may restructure docs.json first; anchoring by the presets entry survives that restructure.

autoDecisions.summary: Whole-file dash cleanup only for configuration/model-presets.mdx and features/cloister.mdx (3 dashes each); section-scoped for concepts.mdx, harnesses.mdx, effort.mdx and docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: The rule says remove dashes from bodies you edit; the large pages are owned by the accuracy audits and PAN-5472, so whole-file rewrites there would collide with sibling PRs.

autoDecisions.summary: Replace the stale routing sections with short pointers rather than deleting the headings.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows delete or rewrite; a pointer keeps readers of Cloister and Concepts one click from the correct page and keeps existing anchors meaningful.
